translations.name: St. Louis Community College Adult Education and Literacy
translations.description: STLCC offers free classes for people who want to finish high school or learn English. High school equivalency classes are for people age 16 or older; if you are 16 or 17, extra school rules apply. Rules for other classes may differ. Orientation is required and walk-ins are not accepted. Class availability varies, so check the website for current enrollment details.
translations.website_description: Free high school equivalency and English classes
